name: producer_fifo_top_broken_blockprops
comment: The same broken assembly judged by the two blocks' OWN properties -- exactly the properties assertforge generates from a block's intent. This is the control that makes the seam result mean something: if these also failed, the seam assertions would be redundant.

assertions.name: B1_counter_advances_by_exactly_one
assertions.why: the counter's own property, stated on the counter's own ports

assertions.name: B2_fifo_occupancy_bounded_by_depth
assertions.why: the FIFO's own property, stated on the FIFO's own state

assertions.name: B3_fifo_full_means_full
assertions.why: the FIFO's own property on its own derived output

assertions.name: B4_fifo_empty_means_empty
assertions.why: the FIFO's own property on its own derived output
